summary: Viking Therapeutics filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement under its automatic shelf registration for an underwritten common stock offering alongside a concurrent convertible senior notes offering due 2032. Terms are blank in this preliminary filing; the reference price is $40.85 as of September 22, 2026, with a 30-day underwriters' option. Morgan Stanley and J.P. Morgan are bookrunners. The two offerings are not conditioned on each other. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch final pricing, dilution, and note terms.
